name: Glass code diff
oneLiner: a code editor on a glass pane: the old lines flush red and fold away, the new lines open in green and type themselves in, then the +12 -4 change chip stamps onto the tab with its diffstat squares
say: when the speaker says the code changed or an agent rewrote something ('it rewrote the function', 'one small change'): the red folds away on 'removed', the green types in on 'added', the chip stamps on the size of the change
